title: CDMD: A Cross-Dataset Mixed-Type Diffusion Model for Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.39124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models for tabular data are typically trained separately for each dataset, limiting knowledge transfer and requiring the storage of many specialized models. In this paper, we introduce CDMD, a tabular diffusion model trained jointly across heterogeneous datasets with different schemas and variable numbers of numerical and categorical features. Unlike existing cross-dataset tabular diffusion models that operate in continuous representation spaces, CDMD defines diffusion directly over the mixed-type feature space and is trained end-to-end. To accommodate heterogeneous categorical domains, we introduce a schema-restricted reverse-process parameterization for masked diffusion models, in which the output space dynamically adapts to each feature's vocabulary. translated_title: CDMD：一种面向表格数据的跨数据集混合类型扩散模型
translated_abstract: 表格数据的生成模型通常需要针对每个数据集单独训练，这限制了知识迁移，并且需要存储大量专门化的模型。在本文中，我们提出了CDMD，这是一种在具有不同模式（schema）以及不同数量数值型和类别型特征的异构数据集上联合训练的表格扩散模型。与现有的在连续表示空间中运行的跨数据集表格扩散模型不同，CDMD直接在混合类型特征空间上定义扩散过程并进行端到端训练。为了适应异构的类别型特征域，我们为掩码扩散模型引入了一种模式受限的反向过程参数化方法，其中输出空间会动态适应每个特征的词表。随后，我们将数值型和类别型的特征级扩散过程组合成依赖于模式的行级扩散过程。一个共享的模式感知Transformer去噪器能够捕获各特征之间的依赖关系。
tldr: CDMD是一种直接在混合类型特征空间上定义扩散过程、可在具有不同模式的异构数据集上联合训练的表格扩散模型，通过模式受限的反向过程参数化和共享的模式感知Transformer去噪器，实现了跨数据集的知识迁移与端到端训练。
en_tdlr: CDMD is a tabular diffusion model that defines diffusion directly over mixed-type feature spaces and is jointly trained across heterogeneous datasets with different schemas, leveraging schema-restricted reverse-process parameterization and a shared schema-aware Transformer denoiser for end-to-end cross-dataset knowledge transfer.
